title: Reef to Islands
style: Australian rap with laid-back boom-bap swing, dusty kick-snare pocket, clipped bass and hand percussion; verse rides nimble internal rhymes and local slang, pre-chorus tightens with filtered chops and a rising whistle, chorus opens on gang vocals and a chantable anchor. Ad-lib doubles punch key lines, with tape-stop transitions into the bridge and a bright, sun-bleached mix that feels coastal and raw., rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
East coast, Great Barrier, long blue stretch
Coral in the shallows, fish in the net
West side, Abrolhos, rocky little crown
Salt on the boots when the sun goes down
You say "yeah nah," I say "good on ya, mate"
Different little code, same grin, same state
One got a reef, one got island time
Both got a cut of that coastal shine
From the sand flats to the bommie lines
I’m reading the map like a punchline

[Pre-Chorus]
West wind cut clean
East swell roll in
Same sun up top
Different way we spin
You go one way
I go another
Still the same country
Still my brother

[Chorus]
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
West to east, we vibin'
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
Different shore, same drivin'
Good on ya, mate (good on ya, mate)
Come and take a look
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
That’s the whole book

[Verse 2]
Bro says "heaps," I say "mad as"
She says "reckon," I say "too true, that"
Palm tree lean in the humid air
Wind off the water, no city glare
Barrier got the long-lens glow
Abrolhos got the small-island show
One got the turtle, one got the quokka grin
Both got a story you can paddle in
Don’t need a suit, just a sand-scraped heart
Skipper voice and a map-marked chart

[Pre-Chorus]
West wind cut clean
East swell roll in
Same sun up top
Different way we spin
You go one way
I go another
Still the same country
Still my brother

[Chorus]
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
West to east, we vibin'
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
Different shore, same drivin'
Good on ya, mate (good on ya, mate)
Come and take a look
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
That’s the whole book

[Bridge]
[Half-time]
Talk is cheap till you step that foam
Hear that gull cry, feel that dome
East got the buzz, west got the hush
Same salt truth in the tide and crush
Say it proper, say it proud
Aussie slang in a rolling crowd
From the coral edge to the island stone
Different slang, same home

[Chorus]
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
West to east, we vibin'
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
Different shore, same drivin'
Good on ya, mate (good on ya, mate)
Come and take a look
Reef to islands (reef to islands)
That’s the whole book
